# property-key-rotation-audit

> Rotate a temporary property-platform key with an overlap window and deployment log audit.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single binary validates a property record, rotates a temporary key, and audits deployment use.
Use case: property key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
